## About

Product Design Lead and hands-on staff-level designer with 9+ years of experience taking complex digital products from discovery to launch and post-launch review. I work across AI, developer tools, fintech, marketplaces, telecom, and consumer products.

I started as a software developer, which lets me move between product strategy, product management, research, interaction design, coded prototypes, and engineering delivery. I build product design practices and AI interaction systems, manage and develop designers, and partner with Product, Engineering, Research, and Data while remaining hands-on.

Selected evidence:

• Co-authored Trust-Calibrated Code Review: translated 64 practitioner problems from 17 discovery participants into an IDE workflow validated with 43 professionals. 72% would use the proposed tool, 63% expected lower overall review effort, and 52% expected lower trust-assessment effort.

• Led the product model and public-preview launch of AI Assistant for VS Code across eight languages; the extension reached 29,370 unique Marketplace installs by 24 Aug 2026.

• Built a reusable AI interaction system across developer tools: contextual entry points, visible context, agent plans, execution control, evidence review, and safe recovery patterns used across Rider, ReSharper, VS Code, and R&D prototypes.

• Led four TON Wallet journeys and their Telegram integration. Registered wallets grew from 382,148 to 901,015 in the launch quarter (+136%; team-level product result).

• Built and led a multidisciplinary design team at TON Foundation / TOP, anchored by four product designers and spanning motion, graphic and illustration, and marketing design. Guided launch readiness for Getgems and STON.fi; later public scale reached $7.6B in volume, 36.4M swaps, and 5.8M users for STON.fi, and 4.5M+ connected wallets for Getgems.

• Designed five connected SberMobile journeys across bank, telecom, and employee surfaces. During the product period, SberMobile reached 500,000 active subscribers and expanded to 50 regions (team-level product result).

• Built Rider's design practice and managed three product designers, owning hiring, individual goals, performance reviews, development plans, compensation decisions, and team composition. During the Rider product period, surveyed primary-IDE share increased from 35% to 44% (team-level adoption outcome).

Current focus: AI product design, AI design systems, LLM UX, agentic workflows, developer tools, platform design, complex internal tools, systems design, product strategy, product management, product discovery, qualitative and quantitative research, experimentation, product analytics, and multidisciplinary design leadership.

## Publication

Title: Trust-Calibrated Code Review

Publisher: JetBrains × Lund University

Publication date: June 2026

URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01969

Description: Participatory design study on reviewing multi-file changes produced by LLM agents. The work translated 64 practitioner problems identified with 17 discovery participants into a three-level IDE workflow validated with 43 professionals. 72% would use the proposed tool, 63% expected lower overall review effort, and 52% expected lower trust-assessment effort.
